credit_policy: Every failed witness remains zero credit. A recovered bounded component never rewrites its failure and same-owner recovery never becomes independent reproduction.

records.failed_witness: One combined pretty projection of six source manifest and receipt documents exceeded the available model context and truncated before attributable completion.
records.recovery: Inspect exact property names and scalar counts first, then recompute immutable Git blob and byte parity without printing every entry.
records.passing_witness: All 71 source-to-evidence entries matched exact target Git blobs and byte counts, with zero path issue; source-to-final contained exactly 94 changed paths.
records.recurrence_guard: Project manifest scalars and recompute commitments instead of dumping complete entry arrays.
records.rollback: The display failure changed no file, Git object or receipt and earned zero manifest credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Prefer exact scalar and commitment equality over broad manifest output.

records.failed_witness: A PowerShell branch-existence probe placed a native command and LASTEXITCODE expression inside one parenthesized assignment and failed parser validation before Git ran.
records.recovery: Run the native command first, capture LASTEXITCODE in a separate scalar and construct the summary object afterward.
records.passing_witness: The corrected probe proved the Sable path, local branch and remote branch were all absent before creation.
records.recurrence_guard: Evaluate native commands before summary expressions and never embed command separators inside PowerShell parentheses.
records.rollback: The parser failure ran no Git command and changed no branch or filesystem state.
records.sibling_recommendation: Sequence native probes and scalar summaries explicitly.

records.failed_witness: The combined sparse-init, sparse-set, checkout and attribution wrapper returned only the checkout line before its intended summary became visible.
records.recovery: Do not replay setup; inspect the actual target branch, head, sparse rules, materialized tracked files and status read-only.
records.passing_witness: The exact Sable branch existed at the immutable source with six active sparse patterns, four materialized tracked files and a clean index.
records.recurrence_guard: Separate mutation steps from a bounded read-only attribution receipt when output can be truncated.
records.rollback: No retry mutation was required; the incomplete wrapper attribution remains zero credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Inspect actual setup state before retrying any incomplete wrapper.

records.failed_witness: A bulk x1-template size loop passed an accidental newline as a Git revision and emitted repeated ambiguous-argument failures, so byte-size results earned no credit.
records.recovery: Use an explicit literal path array, resolve each revision-path expression independently and query the exact Git blob size.
records.passing_witness: All eight Auren x1 template blob sizes and top-level schemas were recovered with exact literal paths.
records.recurrence_guard: Never derive Git revision-path arguments from an unfiltered multi-line native command result.
records.rollback: The malformed reads changed no working file or Git object and earned zero size credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Materialize and validate literal path arrays before Git blob loops.

records.failed_witness: A final-seal projection guessed a nonexistent final/final-seal.json path and returned a path-not-found error.
records.recovery: Query the exact owner phase Git tree for seal and phase-truth names before reading the small located file.
records.passing_witness: The seal was located at seal/final-seal.json and read through EOF without sibling enumeration.
records.recurrence_guard: Resolve lifecycle artifact locations from the exact Git tree before filesystem or blob reads.
records.rollback: The guessed read changed no file or repository state.
records.sibling_recommendation: Do not infer lifecycle directories from shortened artifact names.

records.failed_witness: A Method Flow projection guessed a nonexistent method-flow/final-method-flow-ledger.json path and produced null fields.
records.recovery: List only exact method-flow-named paths under the Auren phase and inspect the x2 and terminal operational ledgers separately.
records.passing_witness: The 25-row x2 ledger, three-row operational ledger and three-row terminal mirror were located and reconciled without mutation.
records.recurrence_guard: Inspect real lifecycle filenames before projecting schema fields.
records.rollback: The null projection changed no ledger and earned zero Method Flow credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Treat guessed schema paths and null projections as retained failures.

records.failed_witness: A PowerShell all-candidate semantic-similarity loop exceeded its bounded startup envelope and returned no attributable corpus result.
records.recovery: Use a read-only in-memory Python pass over seven exact Git JSON blobs with token sets and bounded top-neighbor output.
records.passing_witness: The recovered implementation completed quickly and produced bounded semantic neighbors across the reconstructed chain.
records.recurrence_guard: Use an efficient in-memory corpus algorithm after a measured shell-loop scaling failure; write no scratch file.
records.rollback: The timeout wrote no file and changed no branch or repository state.
records.sibling_recommendation: Benchmark corpus loops before broad PowerShell cross-products.

records.failed_witness: The first optimized corpus pass assumed every later proposal row used a title field and failed with KeyError on two older remaster schemas that use description.
records.recovery: Inspect exact row keys and normalize each label as title-or-description before recomputing the chain.
records.passing_witness: The corrected pass reconstructed exactly 3650 labels and exposed genuine collisions and low-neighbor candidate surfaces.
records.recurrence_guard: Inspect schema generations and preserve compatibility fallbacks before aggregating historical rows.
records.rollback: The failed read-only process wrote no artifact and earned zero novelty credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Normalize historical proposal label fields explicitly rather than assuming a current schema.

boundary: Operational workflow evidence only. These failures and recoveries establish no scientific result, production assurance, professional authority, legal or cultural authority, Maori authority or independent reproduction.
